name: @helpdesk/knowledge-gateway
description: Knowledge gateway: MCP server, one tool (search_documentation), no policy config beyond the structural rules, no Graph permission, no backend client and no credential at all (SPRINT3.md, 3.3) — the case @helpdesk/gateway-core exists to make first class. Lexical search over a small, pinned-commit corpus of Microsoft Learn documentation for Entra and Intune, vendored under corpus/raw.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/gateway-core build && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/gateway-core build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/gateway-core build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
